There was once a post on /r/subredditcancer where someone had looked at a bunch of reposts and found that the top few comments from the original post were always repeated in the repost. So like, if a real human posts a video or a pic - it doesn't go viral but it gets a few thousand comments. Several months later, it will be reposted, and the top two or three comments from the first time will always appear in the new thread. It was theorized that this was part of an algorithm cultivating karma in these accounts.
